_comment: Single source of truth for which EP-weights file scores a spec at a given max phase. ep_weights_path_for() (scripts/assemble_universe.py) and resolveEpWeightsPath() (packages/core/src/ep-weights.ts) both read this file and apply the same rule: highest key in byPhase that is <= maxPhase, falling back to `fallback` when byPhase is empty or has no entry at or below maxPhase. Ticket 159 -- do not hand-copy this mapping into either language again.
